text:
juno park: morning team — I'm starting today. Quick ask: who sets up shared HubSpot queues and the Aircall extension? Also where's the freshest AE vs SDR playbook (we have slightly different voicemails/cadences right?). Thanks!

mike (sales-ops): welcome juno! Sales-Ops owns HubSpot queues + sequences. I created ticket SO-9712 to add you to "AE-Queue" and copy the SDR cadence if you want. Which role are you ramping for (AE or SDR)?

juno park: AE. Would love the AE cadence and the short voicemail scripts per role. Also want call logging to go to a shared inbox for team handoffs.

tara it: @juno park send your laptop hostname and Okta email. For HubSpot queue access we need you to be logged into Okta in the same browser. Aircall extension needs your preferred outbound caller ID and timezone.

mike (sales-ops): HubSpot queue invite sent 705. Shared inbox (sales-ae) created and linked to the queue. Sequences: copied AE cadence to your account. If you want a custom AB test cadence tell me.

olivia enablement: AE playbook: https://notion.redwood/sales/playbooks/ae-playbook-2026  SDR playbook: https://notion.redwood/sales/playbooks/sdr-playbook-2026. Voicemail scripts (short): AE: "Hi, this is Juno from Redwood Inference. Sorry I missed you 1 please leave your name and best time and I'll call back." SDR: "Hey, this is [Name] at Redwood 1 quick call to see if you're exploring LLM infra options. Leave a time and I can follow up."

juno park: nice. where do battlecards live? want the top 3 to prep for discovery objections.

olivia enablement: Battlecards in Notion: https://notion.redwood/sales/battlecards. Top 3: "Latency ROI", "Private Deploy Tradeoffs", "TCO vs Hosted". Also here's a tiny pasteable price-objection line: `I get it. Most teams see unit-cost reduction within 6-12 weeks after batching and KV caching are configured.`

ben manager: Welcome Juno! Week 1 plan: Mon-Wed shadow AE calls, Thu mock demo, Fri start 2 discovery calls. I'll book a 30m sync to walk through the AE playbook and routing rules. If HubSpot show/hide perms look off let me know.

onboarding-bot: New-hire checklist: https://redwood.internal/onboarding/juno-park  Status: HubSpot (active), Aircall (pending), Gong (pending).

tara it: Aircall extension queued  ETA 45min. For custom voicemail greetings drop your script here or use this template: `Hi, you've reached Juno at Redwood Inference. Leave a brief message and I'll follow up within one business day.` If you want the message recorded from your laptop tell me and I'll flip the transfer.

juno park: thanks all 1 one last Q: how do I route a lead to CS after discovery? we want a smooth handoff.

mike (sales-ops): Use the HubSpot workflow "AE -> CS Handoff": tag contact with `ready-for-cs` and assign to the CS shared inbox. The workflow creates a task in Intercom and posts to #cs-handoffs channel. Docs: https://notion.redwood/sales/workflows/ae-cs-handoff.

olivia enablement: For handoffs use the short email template: subject `Handoff: [Company] — quick context`, body with 3 bullets (problem, what we demoed, next step) and propose 2 times. Keep it <= 5 sentences. Also add the battlecard link for compliance Qs.

juno park: awesome, got it. appreciate the rapid setup :rocket:
